dedupe_keys.name: starkregengefahrenkarten der stadt freiburg i br

description: Starkregengefahrenkarten der Stadt Freiburg i. Br is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by freiburg.de. The spatial data set contains the flood depths and flow velocities for a rare/extraordinary/extreme heavy rain event. This serves in particular as information to assess one's own risk and to carry out appropriate self-preparation. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain hazard maps of the city of Freiburg i. Br" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Starkregen, Starkregenrisikomanagement, Freiburg im Breisgau, Überflutung, Niederschlag. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
